Generated from `decompiled-server-26.1.2/net/minecraft` on 2026-05-24. This file intentionally contains one unchecked task per Java source file so full-port planning can prove every decompiled class has an explicit Rust port/parity-test placeholder. Do not mark an item complete until the corresponding behavior has been audited against Java and covered by Rust implementation tests or an explicit deferral note.

- [x] Audit, port or explicitly defer, and parity-test `decompiled-server-26.1.2/net/minecraft/world/item/alchemy/Potion.java`. — Java 26.1.2 stores a potion registry name, ordered effect list, vanilla feature flags, and detects instant effects by scanning `MobEffectInstance` definitions. Rust `item_alchemy::PotionDef` models the same name/effect surface and `has_instant_effects` checks `status_effect` instant flags. Covered by `VIBECRAFT_SKIP_LINE_CHECK=1 cargo test -q -j 1 item_alchemy -- --nocapture`.
- [x] Audit, port or explicitly defer, and parity-test `decompiled-server-26.1.2/net/minecraft/world/item/alchemy/PotionBrewing.java`. — Java 26.1.2 builds three valid containers, two container mixes, all 63 vanilla potion mixes from `addVanillaMixes` including `addStartMix` expansion, and exposes ingredient/container/potion mix predicates plus `mix(...)`. Rust `item_alchemy::PotionBrewingModel` mirrors those containers, mixes, predicates, and stack transformation, and `container_menus::is_brewing_ingredient` now delegates to that Java-backed graph instead of a heuristic list. Covered by `VIBECRAFT_SKIP_LINE_CHECK=1 cargo test -q -j 1 item_alchemy -- --nocapture`.
- [x] Audit, port or explicitly defer, and parity-test `decompiled-server-26.1.2/net/minecraft/world/item/alchemy/PotionContents.java`. — Java 26.1.2 stores optional potion/custom color/custom effects/custom name, concatenates base and custom effects, scales durations, preserves custom effects, computes weighted visible-effect ARGB color with `BASE_POTION_COLOR` fallback, derives translation suffixes, and treats empty/no-visible effects as no color. Rust `PotionContentsModel` mirrors those data fields and methods for effect enumeration, scaling, mutation, name key, presence checks, and color math. Covered by `VIBECRAFT_SKIP_LINE_CHECK=1 cargo test -q -j 1 item_alchemy -- --nocapture`.
- [x] Audit, port or explicitly defer, and parity-test `decompiled-server-26.1.2/net/minecraft/world/item/alchemy/Potions.java`. — Java 26.1.2 registers 46 built-in potions from `water` through `infested`, with exact display-name aliases, ordered effect lists, durations, and amplifiers. Rust `item_alchemy::POTIONS` mirrors the registry order and effect payloads, including turtle-master multi-effect variants and instant heal/harm variants. Covered by `VIBECRAFT_SKIP_LINE_CHECK=1 cargo test -q -j 1 item_alchemy -- --nocapture`.
- [x] Audit, port or explicitly defer, and parity-test `decompiled-server-26.1.2/net/minecraft/world/item/alchemy/package-info.java`. Java 26.1.2 package marker contains only `@NullMarked`, the package declaration, and the `org.jspecify.annotations.NullMarked` import; no Rust runtime behavior or parity test is required beyond preserving nullability expectations in typed Rust APIs.
